run_eval_epoch: run multi-gpu evaluation of a NeRF model on a dataset and compute PSNR and SSIM metrics
run_render_image: render an image from a NeRF model by processing rays in chunks and returning rgb, depth, acc, and warp
test_eval_epoch: test the eval_epoch function with a custom dataset and data preprocessing function
test_render_image: test the render_image function with sample rays and a trained NeRF model
refactor_eval_epoch: refactor the eval_epoch function to support additional image quality metrics beyond PSNR and SSIM
